goal: Implement the smallest provider-neutral supervised bridge from a persisted VERIFICATION_REQUIRED DiscoveryLead observation to a canonical exact-role JOBS entity only after current first-party employer/ATS evidence verifies the same role and supplies both an exact employer/application-system identity and an exact employer requisition/opportunity identifier. Preserve the original third-party discovery provenance, write Official_URL only from the verified first-party source, remain fail-closed when exact identity is incomplete, and hand the resulting exact operational Job_ID to the already-canonical Slice 2 gate/Match Truth path without changing any existing truth semantics.
acceptance_conditions: Input begins only from durable persisted Slice-1 VERIFICATION_REQUIRED DiscoveryLead provenance reconstructed from LOG. The original unresolved observation remains immutable/auditable and is never rewritten into a resolved observation.

Repository code remains provider-neutral and deterministic: network/browser/search I/O that locates or reads a first-party page stays in the supervised provider layer. The deterministic core consumes a bounded first-party posting observation and emits validated mutation plans only.

A first-party posting observation must include current official_url, observed employer name, observed role title, observed_at, explicit verified employer/application-system identity, and exact employer requisition/opportunity identifier when one is present. Missing required structure fails visibly.

The resolver requires an exact role-title binding under bounded normalization only (Unicode normalization, case folding, and whitespace normalization are permitted; fuzzy title similarity, semantic matching, abbreviation guessing, and company+title identity are forbidden). Employer binding must be explicitly verified from the first-party source and may not be inferred from a third-party source label.

Canonical Job_ID is created only by the unchanged resolve_exact_role_key(exact_employer_identity, exact_requisition_id) semantics. src/exact_role_identity.py is reused unchanged; company/title hashes, LinkedIn/Indeed/Handshake/Simplify IDs, discovery URLs, first-party URL-only identity, and fuzzy fallbacks remain forbidden.
Third-party discovery platform IDs may be preserved only as provenance/source_claims. They can never become or substitute for the employer requisition/opportunity identifier.
Official_URL is populated only from the verified first-party posting; Discovery_URL and original Discovery_Source remain the original nomination provenance and are preserved separately.

For a positively resolved observation, the resolver emits exactly one canonical JOBS CREATE/UPDATE for the exact operational Job_ID plus an auditable FIRST_PARTY_IDENTITY_RESOLUTION LOG record. First_Seen remains the original discovery observation timestamp; Last_Verified reflects the verified first-party observation timestamp.

The resulting JOBS row remains at the existing pre-Slice-2 control-plane state (NORMALIZED) unless current canonical semantics already require otherwise. This milestone must not add a new Pipeline_State enum such as VERIFIED_FOR_GATES.

If the first-party role exists but the employer requisition/opportunity identifier is absent or ambiguous, the observation remains VERIFICATION_REQUIRED, no JOBS row is created, and a visible FIRST_PARTY_IDENTITY_RESOLUTION LOG record preserves why exact identity was not established.

If employer binding, role binding, first-party source authority, or requisition identity is contradictory or ambiguous, fail closed to VERIFICATION_REQUIRED or PROCESSING_ERROR as appropriate; never guess.

Repeated verification of the same DiscoveryLead against byte-equivalent first-party identity evidence is idempotent: no duplicate JOBS entity and no duplicate successful logical resolution record. Durable state rehydration from JOBS/LOG must preserve this convergence across sessions.

Cross-source nominations that resolve to the same exact employer/system + requisition/opportunity converge on one operational JOBS entity while retaining each distinct discovery observation in durable LOG provenance.

The deterministic fixture matrix includes positive MTA 17407, Peraton 2026-171010, and OneMain R2608-52225 cases; Middesk Data Operations Associate and Runlayer Business Operations remain unresolved unless fixture evidence itself contains an exact first-party requisition/opportunity identifier.

Positive fixtures must carry first-party evidence sufficient to prove that the role title and exact requisition came from the employer/ATS source; tests may not simply inject expected Job_ID output without exercising the resolver contract.
Slice 1 email-only behavior is unchanged: the same original five production alert observations still resolve to VERIFICATION_REQUIRED before the first-party verification step.

Slice 2 behavior and Match Truth semantics are unchanged. Only rows successfully resolved to a canonical operational Job_ID may later enter the existing Slice 2 path, under its existing authoritative-input and upstream-gate requirements.

No Employer Truth freshness, geography, OPT/work-authorization, candidate-condition, threshold, actionability, crowding, or Match Truth result is synthesized by this resolver. It establishes exact identity/Official_URL only.

No PURSUE/Bora_Decision, package generation, Drive package persistence, application lifecycle mutation, auto-submit, Vercel, scheduling, Scout/source expansion, browser automation, or new database is implemented.
No Gmail/Google credentials, OAuth secrets, account IDs, spreadsheet IDs, label IDs, or hard-coded user/provider configuration enters the repository.
Existing submitted-opportunity dedupe, application-history, exact-role identity, Slice 1, Slice 2, posting-state/actionability, Golden, milestone/state, and full Assurance behavior remain green.
No path outside allowed_paths changes.
An independent adversarial reviewer evaluates the exact immutable implementation candidate and returns SAFE, or every consequential finding is repaired, revalidated, refrozen, and rereviewed.
stop_conditions: Implementation requires weakening or modifying src/discovery_lead.py or src/exact_role_identity.py.
Implementation requires treating a discovery-platform ID, company/title pair, URL, or fuzzy title/company similarity as canonical identity.
Implementation requires inventing a new Pipeline_State, Employer Truth enum, Candidate Truth enum, Match Truth enum, or changing existing gate/decision semantics.
Implementation requires direct network/browser automation, provider credentials, hard-coded account/sheet configuration, or an additional Scout source inside repository code.
Implementation requires writing a JOBS row when first-party employer/system identity or exact employer requisition/opportunity identifier is missing, ambiguous, or contradictory.
Implementation promotes third-party source freshness/fit/sponsorship/location/work-authorization claims into authoritative truth.
Implementation modifies Match Truth, Candidate Truth, qualification/evidence logic, package generation, application submission, Vercel, scheduling, or a database.
Implementation requires any path outside allowed_paths.
Any Slice 1 fail-closed/idempotency invariant, Slice 2 gate ordering/binding invariant, submitted/application-history invariant, Golden, milestone/state, or full Assurance regression fails.
Independent review finds a consequential defect that cannot be repaired within this bounded identity-resolution seam.
review_requirements: MANDATORY_INDEPENDENT_EXACT_BYTE_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_BEFORE_COMMIT_PUSH; reviewer identity is replaceable, but independence and exact immutable candidate bytes are mandatory. Every implementation mutation invalidates prior green/review evidence.
human_approval_requirements: THIS CONTRACT SELECTION/AUTHORING DOES NOT AUTHORIZE RUNTIME IMPLEMENTATION. AFTER THE GOVERNANCE CONTRACT IS VALIDATED, INDEPENDENTLY REVIEWED, AND CANONICALLY MERGED/RECOVERED UNCHANGED, BORA MUST GIVE A SEPARATE EXPLICIT RUNTIME AUTHORIZATION BEFORE ANY IMPLEMENTATION PATH MUTATION. FINAL IMPLEMENTATION RELEASE/MERGE AUTHORITY ALSO REMAINS SEPARATE. PURSUE AND SUBMIT REMAIN HUMAN GATES.
